anchor_control: anchor RGB + anchor depth, the same full-role bounds as the variant's A/B state; a single view never reaches the >=2-view lifting support, so an anchor state carries the single-view depth bypass and learned priors only

depth_bypass.inputs: context RGB, measured context depth, context cameras; no query
depth_bypass.placement: after the >=2-view support gate: one measured view suffices
depth_bypass.sampling: nearest pixel of the full-resolution measured ray-distance map

only_difference_C0_C1: C1 differs from C0 only by its frozen TRAIN set: TRAIN72 plus 55 TRAIN-EXT scenes instead of TRAIN72 (identical architecture, 64238 parameters and per-seed draw). The recipe is the V11 C1 one: width 32, the 32^3 grid, the bounds rule (CONTEXT_DEPTH: hull of the measured depth and cameras of the role's 3 context frames, anchor frame, frozen x1.1 padding, >=1 m), the frozen V2 C1 loss, 6000 steps and the extra-view rule 'uniform_0_4' drawn from its own generator (seed + 7919); the scene permutation covers the variant's own TRAIN set, so C1's scene order, query slots and ray indices differ from C0's. C0 retrains V11 C1 and must reproduce it bit-for-bit. DEV evaluation and checkpoint selection use the standard 3-view contexts.
state: query-independent; all DEV states sealed before query load; >=2 queries/state
